items.title: New: help for PwD students
items.text: My day now has PwD exam rules with a checklist, and reading settings: an easy-to-read font, more line space, a background colour, a reading ruler, words that light up while the app reads, and Simple mode.

items.title: New in Practice
items.text: 2-minute speed drills (tables, squares, fractions to %), a 5-question mini set, a 15-minute study block, and scribe practice. Maths mistakes now show a picture too (ratio, time and work, speed).

items.title: Current affairs for 26 November added
items.text: 16 news items and an 8-question quiz. From now on the update runs every morning at 4:45 AM, and you will see a message here when something important changes.
